llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam indicators: it mimics the Lazada e-commerce platform (logos, categories), offers unbelievably steep discounts (up to 99% off), guarantees 100% payouts on gambling, and uses urgency and psychological tactics. All navigation links funnel to an unrelated domain. Legitimate company information and professional contact methods are absent, replaced by offsite 'live chat'. Search engine and social media checks return no evidence of a legitimate business, but rather confirmation of gambling promotion. This fits the patterns of Fake Online Shopping scams—impersonating a trusted retailer, promising unrealistic rewards/discounts, and providing no verifiable company identity.
